title: Adopt swift-issue-reporting in Vaporize with an explicit severity and containment policy
createdBy: codex@loom from the IssueReporting adoption discussion

historicalContent.description: Add the accepted swift-issue-reporting release to the narrow Vaporize targets that implement and test runtime issue capture. Record the recoverable-invariant severity ladder before converting any production seam, and prove that SwiftPM resolves one IssueReporting implementation.
historicalContent.dependencyRule: Use swift-issue-reporting 2.0.0 directly in the Vaporize graph. Do not introduce swift-case-paths or legacy compatibility-overlay package identities into this graph as part of this task. Save `swift package show-dependencies` evidence with one IssueReporting module implementation.
severityLadder: Expected domain or user failure: typed error, Result, validation, or user-facing state.
Recoverable internal invariant: reportIssue followed by an explicit return, quarantine, discard, or known fallback.
External operational failure: structured log, telemetry, retry, or user-facing recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Package.swift pins swift-issue-reporting from the accepted 2.0.0 release line and only the required targets import IssueReporting.
Package.resolved and show-dependencies prove one IssueReporting implementation and no accidental compatibility-overlay identity.
The Vaporize engineering DocC states that build, test, and run have different runtime-issue semantics.
The policy requires every report site to state invariant, containment, reporter behavior, and proof.
A clean Vaporize build and focused dependency tests pass through the installed Vaporize toolchain lane.
Removing the dependency and reporter target is documented as the rollback.

implementationEvidence.graphProof: Vaporize toolchain show-dependencies emitted exactly one swift-issue-reporting node at 2.0.0 and no legacy compatibility-overlay node; Package.resolved contains the same single pin.
buildProof: Vaporize toolchain swift build --product VaporizeIssueReporting passed.
Vaporize toolchain swift build --product vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh passed.
implementationEvidence.testProof: Vaporize toolchain previously passed 7 structured reporter tests. The prior receipt-suite proof was invalidated because it included a prohibited test framework; its corrected Swift Testing-only verification remains tracked by the open test-receipt task.
implementationEvidence.rollback: Remove the swift-issue-reporting dependency, VaporizeIssueReporting product and target, focused test target, consumer installation calls, and the package pin.
